newsitem.title: USA: Martek sees product used more in '97.
newsitem.headline: Martek sees product used more in '97.

text.p: Martek Biosciences Corp said on Monday it expects broad introductions of term infant formulas containing Martek's nutritional oils in late 1997 at the earliest.
Signifance revenues from this product prior to the fourth quarter of fiscal may not be achieved, Martek said.
Martek's shares fell 3-3/4 to 25 on 141,500 shares of volume. The company was not immediately available for comment about its prior expectations for sales.
Martek said a low-birth weight infant formula containing its long-chain polyunsaturated fatty acids was introduced in the United Kingdom.
Also, Martek said Source Naturals Inc has introduced capsules that use Martek's formula to be sold in health food stores.
Martek said it is not able to predict when, or if, the company's other licensees will introduce or expand their offerings of products containing Martek's oils.
